title: Strategy
description: Fuel, pit window and stop plan from the strategy service.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.query: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.description: Opens on the vehicle this pit is deployed for (OPENLAPS_VEHICLE_ID); any other vehicle with data in the time range can be picked.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.definition: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.description: Every session this vehicle has laps in, newest first, whatever the time range.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every rule in the openlaps folder that is firing right now, wherever you are looking. Acknowledge on the annunciator (notifier, port 8086); this strip shows, it does not silence.

panels.title: Fuel remaining

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, fuel_remaining_l AS "Fuel remaining", fuel_remaining_lo_l AS "Safe figure", rebase_confidence AS "Last anchored on" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Fuel in the tank: the ECU's fuel-used counter counted down from the last known level. Safe figure is the low end of that estimate. Last anchored on says where the known level came from: full (sender read full after a refuel), assumed_full, operator (a fuel mark), surge (surge-tank switch closed) or plan (full tank assumed at the start).

panels.title: Laps to dry

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, laps_to_dry_lo AS "Safe (radio this)", laps_to_dry_hi AS "Best case", burn_laps AS "Burn averaged over (laps)" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Laps until the tank is dry. Safe is the lower bound: the low end of the fuel estimate over a high burn (mean plus two standard deviations of recent clean laps). Best case is the other end. Burn averaged over says how many laps the burn figure rests on: three laps is a guess, a full stint is not.

panels.title: Time to empty

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, time_to_dry_s_lo AS "Safe", time_to_dry_s_hi AS "Best case", time + time_to_dry_s_lo * interval '1 second' AS "Empty at" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Laps to dry as running time at the strategy service's reference lap time. Safe is the lower bound; Empty at is the clock time it falls on. Under a safety car the burn drops and this stretches.

panels.title: Pit window

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, window_open_lap AS "Opens at lap", window_close_lap AS "Closes at lap", stops_needed AS "Stops needed" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: From the strategy service. Opens: the earliest lap the car can stop and still reach the end on the planned number of stops. Closes: the last lap it can stay out on the safe fuel figure. Empty when the car makes the end without stopping.

panels.title: Target lap time

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, target_lap_s AS "Target lap" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: The lap time that reaches the next planned stop (or a time-authority race end) exactly dry: time to that moment over laps to dry. Only defined when the next stop is planned at a wall-clock time -- against a stop at a lap, pace does not change whether the fuel lasts.

panels.title: Driver time remaining

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, driver AS "Driver", driver_time_remaining_s AS "Continuous", driver_total_remaining_s AS "Total" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Against the race plan's regulation limits: remaining continuous time in this stint and remaining total for this driver. A strategy finding fires within the configured margin and goes critical past the limit.

panels.title: Refuel release in
panels.description: Counts down in the browser, every second, to the earliest legal release: the PitEntryRefuel crossing plus the race plan's minimum refuelling time (8 min). Read from the refuel line crossings of the last 45 minutes, so it starts when the car crosses the line and does not wait for a lap. Shows RELEASE once the minimum has passed and clears when the car crosses PitExitRefuel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT now() AS time,
       (SELECT CASE WHEN e.event ->> 'type' = 'pit_entry'
                    THEN e.time + make_interval(secs => COALESCE((SELECT rp.refuel_min_s FROM v_session_active a JOIN v_race_plan rp ON rp.session_id = a.session_id WHERE a.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' LIMIT 1), 480))
               END
        FROM (SELECT s.time, s.value_text::jsonb AS event
              FROM v_samples_named s
              WHERE s.channel = 'lap.event' AND s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
                AND s.value_text IS NOT NULL AND s.time > now() - interval '45 minutes') e
        WHERE e.event ->> 'type' IN ('pit_entry', 'pit_exit') AND lower(e.event ->> 'line') LIKE '%refuel%'
        ORDER BY e.time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Release at"

panels.title: Fuel used per lap and rolling five-lap mean

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, fuel_used_l AS "Fuel used per lap", avg(fuel_used_l) OVER (ORDER BY crossed_at ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Rolling five-lap mean" FROM v_lap_fuel WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND measurement_status = 'clean' ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: Counter-reset laps are gaps, never negative spikes; uncertainty is visible through the rolling sample count.

panels.title: Fuel remaining (counter), with bounds

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, fuel_remaining_l AS "Fuel remaining", fuel_remaining_lo_l AS "Lower bound", fuel_remaining_hi_l AS "Upper bound" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY time

panels.description: Fuel remaining from the Haltech fuel-used counter, counted down from the last anchor (a full tank or an operator fuel mark). The tank level sender is not drawn here.

panels.title: Laps to dry, with bounds

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, laps_to_dry_lo AS "Laps to dry (lower)", laps_to_dry_hi AS "Laps to dry (upper)", window_close_lap AS "Window closes at lap" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY time

panels.description: The strategy service's projection per evaluation, drawn as a band between its lower and upper bound rather than one line: a projection from three laps is wide and one from a full stint is narrow, and the crew can see which they are looking at. Counter-reset laps are excluded from the burn, never averaged in. Strategy alerts annotate this panel.

panels.title: Burn per lap used by strategy, and fuel added at stops

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, burn_l_per_lap AS "Burn per lap (rolling mean)", burn_l_per_lap + 2 * burn_sd AS "Burn upper bound", fuel_added_l AS "Fuel added at refuel" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY time

panels.description: The rolling mean over the last clean laps (in-laps, out-laps, counter resets and lap-time outliers excluded) and its upper bound, which is what laps to dry is computed against. Fuel added is the level after a refuel less the level before it: a short fill shows here and raises a strategy finding.

panels.title: Stop plan: what the numbers say vs what the operator entered

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.time, (stop ->> 'lap')::int AS "Stop at lap", stop ->> 'type' AS "Type", stop ->> 'reason' AS "Why", stop ->> 'driver_in' AS "Driver in", (stop ->> 'planned_lap')::int AS "Operator planned lap", (stop ->> 'delta_laps')::int AS "Drift (laps)" FROM v_strategy_latest s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.stop_plan) AS stop WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' ORDER BY 2

panels.description: Recomputed every lap from the burn, the stop minimum and the driver limits, and diffed against the race plan entered on the session UI, so the gap between the plan and what the numbers now say is visible before it is a problem. A drift beyond the configured laps raises a strategy finding.

panels.title: Open strategy findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT opened_at AS time, monitor AS "Monitor", severity AS "Severity", summary ->> 'message' AS "Detail" FROM v_watch_findings WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND monitor LIKE 'strategy.%' AND closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC

panels.description: Driver time within its margin, the pit window closing, the computed plan drifting from the operator's, a short fill. Each is also a Grafana alert (strategy-warning, strategy-critical) that reaches the annunciator and the phones.

options.content: All of this comes from the strategy service; no panel does its own arithmetic. Fuel is the ECU's fuel-used counter counted down from the last known level, not the tank sender. **Radio the safe figure.** In-laps, out-laps, outliers and laps with a counter reset are left out of the burn. The refuelling minimum comes from the race plan.
